items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: the only person that I can really remember offhand would be Pigmeat Markham

ctx.x: Do you remember who, what artists were appearing?
Well, I can't -- the only person that I can really remember offhand would be Pigmeat Markham, who, you know, made quite a name for himself. "Here comes the judge." Remember him?
